description:
Optimize the startup performance of the DashboardApp by refactoring a heavy, initially hidden layout into a ViewStub.

The project contains `StatsActivity` which has a complex "Detailed Statistics" panel (ID: `details_panel`) inside `activity_stats.xml`. This panel is set to `visibility="gone"` but still impacts inflation time.

Your task:
1. Extract the entire `details_panel` LinearLayout and its children into a new layout file named `layout_stats_details.xml`.
2. In `activity_stats.xml`, replace the original `details_panel` with a `ViewStub` that references the new layout. Use ID `stub_details` for the ViewStub.
3. Update `StatsActivity.kt` to inflate the ViewStub only when the "Show Details" button is clicked. If the view is already inflated, simply toggle its visibility.
4. Verify the app builds and runs correctly.
